title: sawers-rellan-labs/zealgt pipeline parameters
description: ZEAL genotyping: raw libraries to analysis-ready CRAMs (CRAM workflow) and CRAM store to ancestry and imputed genotypes (genotype workflow)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: The single sample sheet (meta/samples.csv, built by meta/build_samples.py): library, raw location, inline barcodes and read-group fields per sample. --entry read_demultiplexing takes the rows of --libraries.
input.help_text: Validated against assets/schema_input.json at parameter validation and parsed with samplesheetToList.

import_sheet.description: --entry markdup_import: existing CRAMs / BAMs to import (meta/dev_import.csv).
import_sheet.help_text: Parsed and validated with samplesheetToList against assets/schema_import.json only by the markdup_import entry. It has no `schema` key here on purpose: parameter validation would otherwise check that every CRAM in the sheet exists on every run of every entry.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

workflow_and_entry.title: Workflow and entry
workflow_and_entry.description: Which workflow runs and from which stage (docs/PLAN_pipeline.md §3).

workflow.description: cram: raw libraries -> analysis-ready CRAMs; genotype: CRAM store -> genotypes (run card -params-file docs/runs/<run>.yml).

entry.description: Entry of the chosen workflow. cram: read_demultiplexing (raw library -> CRAMs) or markdup_import (existing CRAMs -> duplicate marking + read groups), both ending at the CRAM stop point. genotype: one stage, run alone on the store outputs of the stages before it: sample_quality_control, variant_discovery, ancestry_inference, marker_union, donor_allele_calling, genotype_imputation, reporting. An entry of the other workflow is refused.

force_demux.description: Libraries to demultiplex although the registry lists them (PLAN §0 Task 2).

max_libraries.description: Libraries per read_demultiplexing run (one library in flight, PLAN §5 rule 3).

subsample.description: Read pairs per library for Gate 1 (0 = all); each lane gives its first ceil(N / lanes) pairs. With N > 0, --store must be a directory named subsample_<N> (e.g. <store>/subsample_<N>), so a subset never lands where the real CRAMs go.

import_sets.description: markdup_import: restrict to these import_set values (comma-separated).

raw_r1_glob.description: R1 lane files of a plain-FASTQ library inside its raw_location.

raw_r2_glob.description: R2 lane files of a plain-FASTQ library inside its raw_location.

store_and_reference.title: Store and reference
store_and_reference.description: Permanent store (storeDir, /rsstu) and the B73 v5 reference.

store.description: Store root: demux_qc/, cram/, cram_import/, registry/ (PLAN §5 rule 2). A --subsample run needs a store named subsample_<N>; a stub run one named store_stub* (conf/stub.config).

fasta.description: B73 v5 FASTA with .fai and the minibwa index (.l2b, .mbw) next to it.

registry_seed.description: Libraries demultiplexed before zealgt (PLAN §0), counted as registered.

read_processing_settings.title: Read-processing settings
read_processing_settings.description: Decided settings (PLAN §3, §4), recorded in every provenance record. Change only deliberately.

read_structure_symmetric.description: R1 and R2 read structure (fgbio notation) of symmetric inline-barcode libraries (BC1, BC2S3 batch 2).

read_structure_r1_only.description: R1 and R2 read structure of R1-only barcode libraries (BC2S3 batch 1).

trim_adapters.description: Adapter FASTA for Trimmomatic ILLUMINACLIP (TruSeq3-PE-2.fa as shipped with trimmomatic 0.39).

trim_illuminaclip.description: ILLUMINACLIP seed mismatches : palindrome : simple thresholds.

trim_args.description: Trimmomatic steps after ILLUMINACLIP (batch 1's parameters, PLAN §3 row 1b).

genotype_workflow.title: Genotype workflow
genotype_workflow.description: --workflow genotype: sample sheet, CRAM store, keyed genotype store, units and thresholds (genotype design §5). Set them in the run card.

genotype_input.help_text: Parsed and validated with samplesheetToList against assets/schema_genotype.json only by --workflow genotype (no `schema` key here, as import_sheet). CRAM, index, metrics and provenance are resolved as <cram_store>/<store_dir>/<sample_id>.* and checked at initialisation.
genotype_input.description: Genotype sample sheet (meta/genotype_dev.csv, built by meta/build_genotype_sheet.py): sample_id, role, donor, taxon, source, store_dir, mask_r1, mask_r2, include.

cram_store.description: Read-only CRAM store of the CRAM workflow: <cram_store>/{cram,cram_import}/<sample_id>.cram, .crai, .CollectWgsMetrics.coverage_metrics, .provenance.json. The genotype workflow never writes there.

genotype_store_key.description: Required. Names <store>/genotype/<key>/, where the genotype outputs and settings/<stage>.json go; a rerun with the same key and other settings, code or samples is refused (review #7).

input_store_key.description: Key whose store outputs a downstream stage reads (default: genotype_store_key).

donors.description: Required. Donors of this run (sheet column donor), comma-separated.

donor_set.description: Name of the union set; required from marker_union on (names union/<set>.*, donor_alleles/<set>/, genotypes/<set>/).

regions.description: Units of the run: <chrom> or <chrom>:<start>-<end>, comma-separated (chr10 = the whole chromosome; Gate 1 chr10:1-20000000). Each chromosome must have ranges in --lowcopy_bed.

lowcopy_bed.description: Low-copy reference ranges (BED); discovery and counts are restricted to them. chr10 only for now.

qc_panel.description: Blind QC panel positions for stage 2b (COVERAGE_QC, RELATEDNESS_QC, DONOR_CONTENT_QC); unset = panel QC not run, MIN_COVERAGE alone decides.

mappability_priors.description: Directory holding <taxon>.prior.tsv (c grid, weight); required by donor_allele_calling.

mappability_prior_mode.description: taxon: the donor taxon's prior; flat: uniform on the grid (review #11 test).

b73_controls.description: Zero-class pools (sheet rows with role b73_control), comma-separated; must be non-empty outside stub runs.

provenance_check.description: strict: a CRAM whose provenance record disagrees with the current read-processing settings (markdup) stops the run; warn: logged only (PLAN §3).

mask_read_starts.description: Set the first mask_r1 / mask_r2 cycles (from the sheet) to Q0 before every read consumer (5' bias); false = every mask 0, same code path.

imputation_method.description: raster (Eq. S5.1); phg / both are accepted but not implemented yet (WP-PHG).

read_position_qc.description: Reporting: ALT / other fraction by read cycle (the 5' bias residue).

min_coverage.description: 2b: a sample with mean coverage below this fails (PLAN:243).

panel_min_markers.description: 2b coverage QC report: covered panel markers per sample x chromosome.

relatedness_method.description: 2b relatedness: VanRaden-centred kinship from one random read per site (lines) or ALT fractions.

relatedness_seed.description: 2b: seed of the pseudo-haploid read draw.

relatedness_flag_sd.description: 2b: flag relatedness outliers beyond this many SD.

donor_content_expected.description: 2b: expected share of panel sites with ALT reads (12.5 %).

donor_content_flag_low.description: 2b: flag a sample below this donor-content share.

relatedness_qc.description: 2b: run RELATEDNESS_QC when a QC panel is set (pure python: run 2b per donor set).

donor_content_qc.description: 2b: run DONOR_CONTENT_QC when a QC panel is set.

sample_qc_fail_on.description: 2b: panel checks whose flag fails a sample in sample_qc.tsv (MIN_COVERAGE always fails); comma-separated from relatedness, donor_content, panel_coverage.

pileup_args.description: bcftools mpileup options of every count (ALLELE_COUNTS; -I and -a AD are fixed in the script).

crisp_args.description: CRISP options of discovery (--bams/--ref/--bed/--regions/--sm are set by the module).

veto_min_alt_reads.description: 3: keep a CRISP record when the BC2S3 witness has at least this many ALT reads.

tier_counts_source.description: 3: tiers from the CRISP VCF counts or from bcftools mpileup counts at the kept sites.

tier_prior.description: 3/6: prior of a segregating site in the tier posteriors.

tier_zero_class_llr.description: 3/6: LLR below which a donor counts in the zero class.

tier_zero_class_min_reads.description: 3/6: zero-class reads needed to estimate epsilon.

tier_llr_ref.description: 3/6: LLR at or below which a site is tier ref.

tier_a_min_pools_alt.description: 3: pools with ALT reads needed for tier A (review #10).

tier_a_single_pool_min_alt.description: 3: tier A from one pool with at least this many ALT reads (0 = off; review #10).

tier_a_single_pool_max_pools.description: 3: the single-pool tier-A rule applies to donors with at most this many pools (review #10).

hidepth_factor.description: 3/6: flag hidepth above this multiple of the median depth.

af_gt_half_p.description: 3/6: flag af_gt_half when the one-sided binomial p against 1/2 is below this.

tier_inconsistent_min_alt.description: 3/6: flag inconsistent when a pool expected at 0 has at least this many ALT reads.

tier_inconsistent_min_depth.description: 3/6: depth needed for the inconsistent flag.

tier_witness_zero_class.description: 3: the BC2S3 witness pool counts in the zero class when its LLR allows (zealbc1 map.tsv behaviour).

rigidity.description: 4: RTIGER rigidity at rigidity_ref_markers markers per chromosome; scaled per donor x chromosome to its marker density (LINE_MARKER_QC).

rigidity_ref_markers.description: 4: markers per chromosome at which rigidity applies (500 for 100,000 SNPs, user 2026-09-29); effective rigidity = round(rigidity x kept markers per chromosome / this). 0 = rigidity as given.

min_markers_factor.description: 4: a line with fewer than min_markers_factor x rigidity covered own tier-A markers in the region is excluded (PLAN §4 #13).

rtiger_drop_invariant_sites.description: 4: drop sites with 0 ALT reads over all lines before RTIGER (as zealbc1).

gap_alt_posterior.description: 6 step 1 and 2: call ALT when the posterior (log-odds scale) reaches this.

gap_prior_w.description: 6: weight w of the donor mean in the other-donor prior.

gap_prior_scope.description: 6: donors used for k and m of the prior.

gap_prior_source.description: 6 step 1 prior: other_donors (Eq. S5.3), fixed (gap_prior_fixed) or mu_only.

gap_prior_fixed.description: 6: prior at every gap when gap_prior_source = fixed.

reference_donor_tables.description: 5/6: read-only step-4 tables of donors not called in this run, <donor>=<path>,... (union and prior only; Gate 1: zealbc1 Zx.0570_P2).

reference_donor_taxa.description: 6: taxon of each reference donor, <donor>=<taxon>,... (names of reference_donor_tables); required for every reference donor with gap_prior_scope same_taxon (Gate 1: Zx.0570_P2=mexicana).

eps_prior_alpha.description: 6 step 2: alpha of the zero-class epsilon prior (review #1b).

eps_prior_beta.description: 6 step 2: beta of the zero-class epsilon prior (review #1b).

b73_lines_alt_p.description: 6 step 2: ALT reads in x = 0 lines above the zero-class epsilon at p below this block the site (review #1b).

b73_lines_min_alt.description: 6 step 2: ALT reads in x = 0 lines needed before the blocked_b73_lines test (1 = any; 2 if 1 read is too strict at Gate 1).

lambda_sites.description: 6 step 2: sites of the per-line depth scale lambda_i: all x = 0 union sites, or the candidate (missing) sites only as the pilot script.

c_grid_max.description: 6 step 2: upper end of the mappability grid c.

c_grid_step.description: 6 step 2: step of the mappability grid c.

ks_floor.description: 6 step 2: floor of the per-site depth factor k_s.

phg_inbreeding.description: 7 PHG: inbreeding coefficient F of find-paths.

phg_prob_same_gamete.description: 7 PHG: probability of staying on the same gamete.

reporting_expectation.description: 8: genotype-frequency expectation the reports compare with.

breakpoint_window_markers.description: 8: window (markers) around a RTIGER breakpoint for the breakpoint-density check (review #12).

registry.description: 8: sample registry for the edge translation (meta/PROVENANCE.md "Identifiers"): final outputs carry nil_id_resolved, else pedigree_resolved, else sample_id.
registry.help_text: meta/registry.csv (built by meta/build_samples.py); only its resolved columns are read (meta/corrections.csv applied), and a row with exclude = TRUE is refused. SAMPLE_LABELS joins the internal sample_id on it once, at reporting. Its path, sha256 and the repo commit are recorded in <unit>.sample_labels.tsv, with each sample's correction_ids; it is not part of the settings guard, so a registry commit does not refuse a rerun under the same key.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files (template; zealgt tests use tests/fixtures)

zealgt_run_options.title: zealgt run options
zealgt_run_options.description: Options of a zealgt run on hazel.

run_id.description: Run name; the run's work/ and TMPDIR go to /share/maize/frodrig4/nf_work/<run_id> (profile hazel).
